data.description: Refactored and optimized Spring Boot microservices, reducing response latency by 20% and improving modularity and maintainability. Actively contributed to code reviews and mentored team members to uphold clean coding standards.

I migrated a legacy Python application to a scalable Java and MySQL backend, improving overall system performance and reliability. I also designed and optimized modular Spring Boot microservices and collaborated closely with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth feature integration and dependable delivery.
